item.title: 372 Multnomah County Residents Died While Homeless in 2024
item.description: Multnomah County's Domicile Unknown report shows 18% decline in homeless deaths from 2023 to 2024. Overdose, transportation, assault are main contributors. by Jeremiah Hayden At least 372 Multnomah County residents died while homeless in 2024, according to the county’s latest Domicile Unknown report.
